security_audit.summary: All 57 static findings are false positives caused by documented ast-grep search patterns, Markdown formatting, or fixed command examples. No executable skill scripts, credential access, malicious network behavior, prompt injection, or unsafe deserialization implementation was found.

content.value_statement: Text searches miss semantic relationships and produce noisy matches. This skill uses ast-grep patterns to locate code structures and prepare focused refactors.
actual_capabilities: Builds ast-grep patterns for functions, calls, imports, hooks, and language-specific structures.
Searches JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust source by syntax tree shape.
Previews and applies structural replacements with ast-grep rewrite options.
Creates reusable YAML rules with conditions, context, messages, and optional fixes.
Provides patterns for locating common security risks and error-prone constructs.
Explains output, context, file filters, CI integration, and rule testing.
limitations: Requires the ast-grep sg command to be installed.
Patterns must match the target language syntax and may need project-specific refinement.
Security matches require human review because structural patterns do not prove exploitability.
Rewrite mode changes files and should be previewed before use.

use_cases.title: Map API Usage
use_cases.description: Locate every call, import, or method shape before changing a shared interface.

use_cases.title: Prepare Large Refactors
use_cases.description: Preview structural replacements across a repository before applying controlled edits.

use_cases.title: Create Security Checks
use_cases.description: Turn risky syntax patterns into reusable ast-grep rules for local and CI scans.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Function Call
prompt_templates.prompt: Find every call to [function name] in [directory]. Show the ast-grep command and summarize matching files.

prompt_templates.title: Search a Language Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ast-grep pattern for [code structure] in [language]. Include context flags and explain each metavariable.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [old structure] and preview a replacement with [new structure]. Do not apply changes. Report edge cases requiring review.

prompt_templates.title: Design a CI Rule Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create tested ast-grep YAML rules for [policy]. Include valid examples, invalid examples, severity, CI commands, and false-positive review guidance.

output_examples.input: Find React effects with an empty dependency list.
output_examples.output: A focused ast-grep search command, a list of matching files, and a note that each match needs behavioral review.

output_examples.input: Plan a var-to-const migration without changing files.
output: A structural search and replacement preview.
A summary of candidate matches by file.
A review list for declarations that are reassigned.

best_practices: Start with a narrow directory and explicit language before expanding the search.
Preview every replacement and review representative matches before enabling rewrite mode.
Test reusable YAML rules with valid and invalid fixtures before adding them to CI.
anti_patterns: Do not treat every security pattern match as a confirmed vulnerability.
Do not apply repository-wide rewrites before reviewing the preview and version control status.
Do not use a generic pattern when language-specific syntax is required.

faq.question: What is structural search?
faq.answer: Structural search matches syntax tree shapes instead of raw text, so it can find code constructs despite formatting differences.

faq.question: Which languages are covered?
faq.answer: The included references cover JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.

faq.question: Does this skill install ast-grep?
faq.answer: No. Install the sg command separately with a supported package manager before running searches.

faq.question: Can it modify source files?
faq.answer: Yes. Ast-grep can apply replacements with rewrite mode, but the skill recommends previewing changes first.

faq.question: Can it find security vulnerabilities?
faq.answer: It can locate syntax associated with common risks. A human must confirm data flow, reachability, and exploitability.

faq.question: Can I use rules in CI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents YAML rules, tests, result handling, and a GitHub Actions integration pattern.
